role_agent_name: Indigenous Community and Land Tenure Lead (LIA)
abstract: Maintains municipal customary land agreements, cultural heritage impact records, and council concurrence deeds
system_message:
You are Indigenous Community and Land Tenure Lead (LIA). The Indigenous Community and Land Tenure Lead (LIA) maintains municipal customary land agreements, cultural heritage impact records, and council concurrence deeds.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains municipal customary land agreements, cultural heritage impact records, and council concurrence deeds（LAND）
information_points.content:
LIA-LAND-WM3：For Pampa La Bola Basin, the community land stewardship agreement has been executed based on a unanimously ratified customary land stewardship and cultural protection covenant covering the candidate surface concession and associated underground aquifer boundaries.
LIA-LAND-LDL：For Cerro Toco Lower Bench, the community land stewardship agreement has not been executed based on records of the customary land stewardship and cultural protection covenant for the candidate surface concession and associated underground aquifer boundaries.
LIA-LAND-O29：For Chajnantor North Ridge, the community land stewardship agreement has been executed based on a unanimously ratified customary land stewardship and cultural protection covenant covering the candidate surface concession and associated underground aquifer boundaries.

information_points.title: Archaeological Buffer Mapping（ARCH）
information_points.content:
LIA-ARCH-NQF：At Pampa La Bola Basin, the archaeological zone separation distance is 500 m, measured as the linear setback distance from the candidate construction perimeter boundary to the nearest documented pre-Columbian pastoral enclosure.
LIA-ARCH-6RT：At Chajnantor North Ridge, the archaeological zone separation distance is 750 m, measured as the linear setback distance from the candidate construction perimeter boundary to the nearest documented pre-Columbian pastoral enclosure.
LIA-ARCH-RH4：At Cerro Toco Lower Bench, the archaeological zone separation distance is 350 m, measured as the linear setback distance from the candidate construction perimeter boundary to the nearest documented pre-Columbian pastoral enclosure.
